summary.text: Jen Dailey-Provost is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 22 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Jen Dailey-Provost earned a B.S. in marketing from the University of Utah in 2002 and an M.B.A. from Westminster College in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.

She also earned a graduate certificate in international business from Westminster College and a graduate certificate in emergency health and public health from the University of Utah School of Medicine.

Her career experience includes working as the director of human resources at Solitude Ski Corporation and as the executive director of the Utah Association for Justice and of the Utah Academy of Family Physicians.

Dailey-Provost's listed affiliations include the Utah Public Health Association, the American Public Health Association, and the boards of Advantage Services of Utah, the Utah Health Care Institute and the Area Health Education Center.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term she was assigned to the Government Operations Committee, the House Health and Human Services Committee and the Administrative Rules Review Committee.
